en.shaykh-tahir-ridha-jaffer: 26.Muḥammad ibn Sinān narrated from Kulayb al-Asadī, from Ḥasan ibn Muṣʿab, from Saʿd ibn Ṭarīf, from Abū Jaʿfar (a) who said, “
Soften your speech with [even] the hypocrite, love the faithful believer sincerely, and [even] if a Jew were to sit with you, then be gracious in his company.”
